---
title: Appendix without a delimiter, with chapters
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
crossref:
  chapters: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    sections:
      appendix-delimiter: ""
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'Figure 1.1: Body square' 'Theorem 1.1 (A body theorem)' 'Figure A1: Extra square' '(A1)' 'A.1 Detail' 'Theorem A1 (An appendix theorem)' 'See Appendix A'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

# Intro

![Body square.](figure.svg){#fig-body fig-alt="A blue square."}

::: {#thm-body}

## A body theorem

A statement.
:::

See @sec-extra.

# Extra {.appendix #sec-extra}

![Extra square.](figure.svg){#fig-extra fig-alt="A blue square."}

$$
a = b
$$ {#eq-extra}

::: {#thm-extra}

## An appendix theorem

A statement.
:::

## Detail

Detail text.
